html:
D132　进程中断后的恢复演练

第 19 周 · 5 小时。前置阅读为 D131-重启请求与接收端去重。本章使用 Node.js 20、pnpm 10、NestJS 12 与 PostgreSQL。

今天要做出什么

让后台扫描器接手 ready 与 dispatching 任务。用独立 Node 后端进程和真实的本机 HTTP 预览服务，验证突然退出后的三个恢复窗口：投递后回执尚未收取、改派事务进行中、改派已提交但响应没有送达。

目录与时间

★ apps/server/src/agent/durable-worker.service.ts
★ apps/server/test/durable-backend.mjs
★ apps/server/test/durable-recovery.e2e-spec.ts
★ apps/server/src/agent/agent.module.ts
★ apps/server/vitest.config.e2e.ts

★ 为本章新建或修改的文件。闭卷 20 分钟，设计 45 分钟，端到端集成 110 分钟，跑基线与判读 75 分钟，提交 50 分钟。优先完成必做用例，超时先跳过拓展。完整回归的等待时间另计。

零、闭卷回忆

D131　外部重启的结果不明时如何处理？

核对答案

保留 startedAt 与任务号，查询接收方，不自动重发。

D129　为什么复核人要传摘要？

核对答案

决定必须对应复核页面展示过的冻结参数。

D125　上周固定工单评测的分类命中是多少？

核对答案

十张中命中两张；每张只运行一次。

再复测错题本中今天到期的条目。

一、知识点与可运行示例

1.1 恢复从最后提交的检查点开始

测试单独启动完整 Nest 应用 A。A 完成重启投递后被强制停止，独立接收器切换预览服务。应用 B 启动后自行扫描持久状态，取得相同任务的回执。探针访问新预览进程的 /health，核实代次与 PID。

在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.e2e.ts test/durable-recovery.e2e-spec.ts -t "后端在交付后退出由新进程自动收回真实重启回执"。下面的用例取自 apps/server/test/durable-recovery.e2e-spec.ts，第四节列出本章源码；复用的夹具可按导入路径在前置讲义中查阅。

  it('后端在交付后退出由新进程自动收回真实重启回执', async () => {
    const flow = await f.prepare('restart');
    const task = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data;
    const path = '/api/agent/tasks/' + task.id;
    const first = await backend('0');
    const children = [first.child];
    try {
      await post(first.url + path + '/review', f.reviewAuth, { decision: 'approve', digest: task.digest });
      expect((await post(first.url + path + '/resume', f.auth, {})).state).toBe('dispatching');
      await stop(first.child, true);
      const host = launch('dist/agent/preview-host.js', { PREVIEW_TENANT: task.tenantKey, PREVIEW_GROUP: task.groupId });
      children.push(host);
      const boot = z.object({ port: z.number(), pid: z.number(), generation: z.string() });
      const [old] = await once(host, 'message', { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(12000) });
      const [next] = await once(host, 'message', { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(12000) });
      const oldBoot = boot.parse(old), newBoot = boot.parse(next);
      expect(oldBoot.generation).toBe('initial'); expect(oldBoot.pid).not.toBe(newBoot.pid);
      const health = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:' + newBoot.port + '/health', { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(3000) });
      expect(await health.json()).toEqual({ generation: task.id, pid: newBoot.pid });
      const second = await backend('80'); children.push(second.child);
      expect(second.child.pid).not.toBe(first.child.pid);
      const until = Date.now() + 8000;
      let saved = await f.db.durableTask.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: task.id } });
      while (saved.state !== 'completed' && Date.now() < until) {
        await sleep(60); saved = await f.db.durableTask.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: task.id } });
      }
      expect(saved.receipt).toEqual({ action: 'restart', generation: task.id, pid: newBoot.pid });
      expect((await post(second.url + path + '/resume', f.auth, {})).receipt).toEqual(saved.receipt);
      expect(await f.db.auditLog.count({ where: { entityKey: flow.ticket.ticketNo, action: 'durable.dispatched' } })).toBe(1);
      const evidence = { case: 'durable-recovery', backendBefore: first.child.pid, backendAfter: second.child.pid,
        serviceBefore: oldBoot.pid, serviceAfter: newBoot.pid, state: saved.state, generation: newBoot.generation };
      if (process.env.D132_EVIDENCE_FILE) appendFileSync(process.env.D132_EVIDENCE_FILE, JSON.stringify(evidence) + '\n');
      console.info('恢复演练', evidence);
    } finally { for (const child of children.reverse()) await stop(child); }
  }, 60_000);

推导题　怎样区分后台接管与人工重新点击？

答案

先在不发 resume 请求的情况下等待数据库变成 completed，再调用接口取回已有回执。用新旧后端 PID 和独立目标的健康响应证明进程确实更换。

1.2 制造已提交但客户端没收到结果的窗口

只在测试进程的 HTTP 回复位置扣住响应，保持业务代码与事务正常。读库确认 completed 后强停后端，客户端观察到请求失败。在应用 B 使用相同任务编号恢复，只得到原回执和一次改派记录。

在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.e2e.ts test/durable-recovery.e2e-spec.ts -t "改派提交后丢失响应可在新后端取得原回执"。下面的用例取自 apps/server/test/durable-recovery.e2e-spec.ts，第四节列出本章源码；复用的夹具可按导入路径在前置讲义中查阅。

  it('改派提交后丢失响应可在新后端取得原回执', async () => {
    const flow = await f.prepare();
    const row = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data, path = '/api/agent/tasks/' + row.id;
    await f.api.post(path + '/review').set('authorization', f.reviewAuth).send({ decision: 'approve', digest: row.digest }).expect(201);
    const first = await backend('0', true), children = [first.child];
    try {
      const held = once(first.child, 'message', { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000) });
      const lost = fetch(first.url + path + '/resume', { method: 'POST', headers: { authorization: f.auth },
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(12000) }).then(response => response.status, () => 0);
      expect((await held)[0]).toEqual({ event: 'reply-held' });
      const committed = await f.db.durableTask.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: row.id } });
      expect(committed.state).toBe('completed');
      await stop(first.child, true); expect(await lost).toBe(0);
      const next = await backend('0'); children.push(next.child);
      expect((await post(next.url + path + '/resume', f.auth, {})).receipt).toEqual(committed.receipt);
      expect(await f.db.ticketEvent.count({ where: { ticketId: flow.ticket.id, type: 'assigned' } })).toBe(1);
    } finally { for (const child of children.reverse()) await stop(child); }
  }, 60_000);

推导题　为何暂停在回复位置比只模拟一次网络异常更有说服力？

答案

这个位置保证业务提交已经发生。测到客户端失败、数据库成功、旧进程退出、新进程重放同一回执，四者共同描述了实际恢复窗口。

二、自己动手

步骤 1　启动独立的工作进程

提示一 · 方向

观察哪些信息来自数据库，哪些来自操作系统。

提示二 · API

DurableWorker.sweep、fork、/health 和持久回执。

提示三 · 实现顺序

构建服务端，再运行本章接口用例；保存两组 PID 和任务代次，核对只有一次投递审计。

步骤 2　核对权限与业务回执

提示一 · 方向

对一张已经批准的工单改变条件。

提示二 · API

运行 test/durable-recovery.e2e-spec.ts 和本机十题评测。

提示三 · 实现顺序

撤销发起人的角色再触发扫描，检查没有改派；对照十张工单的分类、完成率与耗时。

三、自检与提交

先在根目录运行 pnpm --filter @ops-ticket/server build，再在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.e2e.ts test/durable-recovery.e2e-spec.ts。用三段时间线说明进程何时退出、外部效果何时发生、用户何时取到回执。 另用已批准任务核对两条拒绝路径：数据库拒绝变更冻结的 command，服务端取消成功后扫描器不再改派。 再跑名称含“事务中退出”的用例，核对旧后端退出后检查点仍是 ready，工单事件数从零变为一。

反证 A　在 apps/server/src/agent/durable-worker.service.ts 把 in: ['ready','dispatching'] 临时替为 in: ['dispatching']，运行同一用例。原始失败输出如下。

AssertionError: expected { …(16) } to match object { state: 'blocked', …(1) }

恢复后文件 SHA-256 与实验前相同，同一用例复测通过。

反证 B　在 apps/server/src/agent/durable-executor.service.ts 把 ? 'blocked' : 'expired' 临时替为 ? 'expired' : 'expired'，运行同一用例。原始失败输出如下。

AssertionError: expected { …(16) } to match object { state: 'blocked', …(1) }

恢复后文件 SHA-256 与实验前相同，同一用例复测通过。

四、本章完整源码

下列文件按当天验证工程快照生成。

4.1 进程中断后的恢复演练

apps/server/src/agent/durable-worker.service.ts

import { Injectable, Logger, type OnApplicationBootstrap, type OnModuleDestroy } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { DurableExecutor } from './durable-executor.service.js';

@Injectable()
export class DurableWorker implements OnApplicationBootstrap, OnModuleDestroy {
  private timer?: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;
  private inFlight?: Promise<void>;
  private cursor?: string;
  private readonly log = new Logger(DurableWorker.name);
  constructor(private readonly db: PrismaService, private readonly executor: DurableExecutor) {}
  onApplicationBootstrap() {
    const ms = Number(process.env.DURABLE_WORKER_MS ?? 2500);
    if (!Number.isFinite(ms) || ms < 0) throw new Error('DURABLE_WORKER_MS_INVALID');
    if (ms > 0) this.timer = setInterval(() => {
      this.inFlight ??= this.sweep().catch(() => { this.log.warn('持久任务扫描暂时失败'); }).finally(() => { this.inFlight = undefined; });
    }, Math.max(40, ms));
  }
  async onModuleDestroy() { clearInterval(this.timer); await this.inFlight; }
  async sweep() {
    await this.db.durableTask.updateMany({ where: { state: { in: ['waiting','ready'] }, expiresAt: { lte: new Date() } }, data: { state: 'expired' } });
    const rows = await this.db.durableTask.findMany({ where: { state: { in: ['ready','dispatching'] },
      ...(this.cursor ? { id: { gt: this.cursor } } : {}) }, select: { id: true }, take: 20, orderBy: { id: 'asc' } });
    for (const row of rows) {
      try { await this.executor.advance(row.id); }
      catch { this.log.warn({ message: '任务未推进，下一轮读取持久状态', taskId: row.id }); }
    }
    this.cursor = rows.length === 20 ? rows.at(-1)?.id : undefined;
  }
}

apps/server/test/durable-backend.mjs

// 进程恢复测试启动完整的已构建 Nest 应用，绑定回环随机端口。
import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import { AppModule } from '../dist/app.module.js';
import { TicketsService } from '../dist/tickets/tickets.service.js';
import { configureApp } from '../dist/app.setup.js';
const app = await NestFactory.create(AppModule, { logger: false });
// 仅测试夹具可在数据库已提交后扣住响应，制造客户端收不到回执的窗口。
if (process.env.DURABLE_HOLD_REPLY === '1') {
  app.use((req, res, next) => {
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url.endsWith('/resume')) {
      res.send = () => { process.send({ event: 'reply-held' }); return res; };
    }
    next();
  });
}
// 在同一事务内已经写入检查点、业务尚未提交时通知父测试。
if (process.env.DURABLE_HOLD_TX === '1') {
  const tickets = app.get(TicketsService), reassign = tickets.reassign.bind(tickets);
  tickets.reassign = (ticketNo, dto, username, scope, prepare) => reassign(ticketNo, dto, username, scope, async (...args) => {
    await prepare(...args);
    process.send({ event: 'inside-transaction' });
    await new Promise(resolve => process.once('disconnect', resolve));
    throw new Error('测试进程已断开');
  });
}
configureApp(app);
const server = await app.listen(0, '127.0.0.1');
process.send({ event: 'listening', port: server.address().port });
process.once('disconnect', () => { void app.close(); });

apps/server/test/durable-recovery.e2e-spec.ts

import { fork, type ChildProcess } from 'node:child_process';
import { appendFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { once } from 'node:events';
import { setTimeout as sleep } from 'node:timers/promises';
import type { AddressInfo } from 'node:net';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { DurableWorker } from '../src/agent/durable-worker.service.js';
import { durableFixtures } from './durable-fixtures.js';

function launch(script: string, env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv) {
  return fork(script, [], { env: { ...process.env, ...env }, execArgv: [], windowsHide: true, stdio: ['ignore','ignore','pipe','ipc'] });
}
async function stop(child: ChildProcess, abrupt = false) {
  if (child.exitCode !== null || child.signalCode !== null) return;
  const exit = once(child, 'exit', { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(6000) });
  if (abrupt || !child.connected) child.kill('SIGKILL'); else child.disconnect();
  try { await exit; } catch { child.kill('SIGKILL'); }
}
async function backend(ms: string, holdReply = false, holdTransaction = false) {
  const child = launch('test/durable-backend.mjs', { DURABLE_WORKER_MS: ms, DURABLE_HOLD_REPLY: holdReply ? '1' : '0', DURABLE_HOLD_TX: holdTransaction ? '1' : '0' });
  try {
    const [info] = await once(child, 'message', { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000) });
    return { child, url: 'http://127.0.0.1:' + (info as AddressInfo).port };
  } catch (error) { await stop(child, true); throw error; }
}
async function post(url: string, auth: string, body: object) {
  const res = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { authorization: auth, 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) });
  expect(res.status).toBe(201);
  return (await res.json()).data;
}
describe('跨进程恢复演练', () => {
  let f: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof durableFixtures>>;
  beforeAll(async () => { f = await durableFixtures('DRC'); });
  afterAll(async () => { await f.close(); });

  it('后端在交付后退出由新进程自动收回真实重启回执', async () => {
    const flow = await f.prepare('restart');
    const task = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data;
    const path = '/api/agent/tasks/' + task.id;
    const first = await backend('0');
    const children = [first.child];
    try {
      await post(first.url + path + '/review', f.reviewAuth, { decision: 'approve', digest: task.digest });
      expect((await post(first.url + path + '/resume', f.auth, {})).state).toBe('dispatching');
      await stop(first.child, true);
      const host = launch('dist/agent/preview-host.js', { PREVIEW_TENANT: task.tenantKey, PREVIEW_GROUP: task.groupId });
      children.push(host);
      const boot = z.object({ port: z.number(), pid: z.number(), generation: z.string() });
      const [old] = await once(host, 'message', { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(12000) });
      const [next] = await once(host, 'message', { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(12000) });
      const oldBoot = boot.parse(old), newBoot = boot.parse(next);
      expect(oldBoot.generation).toBe('initial'); expect(oldBoot.pid).not.toBe(newBoot.pid);
      const health = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:' + newBoot.port + '/health', { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(3000) });
      expect(await health.json()).toEqual({ generation: task.id, pid: newBoot.pid });
      const second = await backend('80'); children.push(second.child);
      expect(second.child.pid).not.toBe(first.child.pid);
      const until = Date.now() + 8000;
      let saved = await f.db.durableTask.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: task.id } });
      while (saved.state !== 'completed' && Date.now() < until) {
        await sleep(60); saved = await f.db.durableTask.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: task.id } });
      }
      expect(saved.receipt).toEqual({ action: 'restart', generation: task.id, pid: newBoot.pid });
      expect((await post(second.url + path + '/resume', f.auth, {})).receipt).toEqual(saved.receipt);
      expect(await f.db.auditLog.count({ where: { entityKey: flow.ticket.ticketNo, action: 'durable.dispatched' } })).toBe(1);
      const evidence = { case: 'durable-recovery', backendBefore: first.child.pid, backendAfter: second.child.pid,
        serviceBefore: oldBoot.pid, serviceAfter: newBoot.pid, state: saved.state, generation: newBoot.generation };
      if (process.env.D132_EVIDENCE_FILE) appendFileSync(process.env.D132_EVIDENCE_FILE, JSON.stringify(evidence) + '\n');
      console.info('恢复演练', evidence);
    } finally { for (const child of children.reverse()) await stop(child); }
  }, 60_000);
  it('改派提交后丢失响应可在新后端取得原回执', async () => {
    const flow = await f.prepare();
    const row = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data, path = '/api/agent/tasks/' + row.id;
    await f.api.post(path + '/review').set('authorization', f.reviewAuth).send({ decision: 'approve', digest: row.digest }).expect(201);
    const first = await backend('0', true), children = [first.child];
    try {
      const held = once(first.child, 'message', { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000) });
      const lost = fetch(first.url + path + '/resume', { method: 'POST', headers: { authorization: f.auth },
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(12000) }).then(response => response.status, () => 0);
      expect((await held)[0]).toEqual({ event: 'reply-held' });
      const committed = await f.db.durableTask.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: row.id } });
      expect(committed.state).toBe('completed');
      await stop(first.child, true); expect(await lost).toBe(0);
      const next = await backend('0'); children.push(next.child);
      expect((await post(next.url + path + '/resume', f.auth, {})).receipt).toEqual(committed.receipt);
      expect(await f.db.ticketEvent.count({ where: { ticketId: flow.ticket.id, type: 'assigned' } })).toBe(1);
    } finally { for (const child of children.reverse()) await stop(child); }
  }, 60_000);
  it('进程在事务中退出后新后端从已批准检查点继续', async () => {
    const flow = await f.prepare(), row = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data;
    const path = '/api/agent/tasks/' + row.id;
    await f.api.post(path + '/review').set('authorization', f.reviewAuth).send({ decision: 'approve', digest: row.digest }).expect(201);
    const first = await backend('0', false, true), children = [first.child];
    try {
      const entered = once(first.child, 'message', { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000) });
      const request = fetch(first.url + path + '/resume', { method: 'POST', headers: { authorization: f.auth },
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000) }).then(response => response.status, () => 0);
      expect((await entered)[0]).toEqual({ event: 'inside-transaction' });
      await stop(first.child, true); expect(await request).toBe(0);
      expect((await f.db.durableTask.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: row.id } })).state).toBe('ready');
      expect(await f.db.ticketEvent.count({ where: { ticketId: flow.ticket.id } })).toBe(0);
      const second = await backend('0'); children.push(second.child);
      expect((await post(second.url + path + '/resume', f.auth, {})).state).toBe('completed');
      expect(await f.db.ticketEvent.count({ where: { ticketId: flow.ticket.id, type: 'assigned' } })).toBe(1);
    } finally { for (const child of children.reverse()) await stop(child); }
  }, 60_000);
  it('后台恢复前重新核对发起人的操作权限', async () => {
    const flow = await f.prepare();
    const row = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data;
    await f.api.post('/api/agent/tasks/' + row.id + '/review').set('authorization', f.reviewAuth)
      .send({ decision: 'approve', digest: row.digest }).expect(201);
    const link = await f.db.userRole.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { userId: f.owner.id } });
    await f.db.userRole.delete({ where: { userId_roleId: { userId: link.userId, roleId: link.roleId } } });
    try {
      await f.app.get(DurableWorker).sweep();
      expect(await f.db.durableTask.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: row.id } })).toMatchObject({ state: 'blocked', failureCode: 'ACCESS_CHANGED' });
      expect(await f.db.ticketEvent.count({ where: { ticketId: flow.ticket.id } })).toBe(0);
    } finally { await f.db.userRole.create({ data: link }); }
  });
  it('批准后冻结参数且服务端取消能阻止后台执行', async () => {
    const flow = await f.prepare(), row = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data;
    const path = '/api/agent/tasks/' + row.id;
    await f.api.post(path + '/review').set('authorization', f.reviewAuth).send({ decision: 'approve', digest: row.digest }).expect(201);
    await expect(f.db.durableTask.update({ where: { id: row.id }, data: { command: { ...flow.body.command, reason: '另一个请求' } } }))
      .rejects.toThrow(/durable task is immutable/);
    await f.api.post(path + '/cancel').set('authorization', f.auth).expect(201);
    await f.app.get(DurableWorker).sweep();
    const saved = await f.db.durableTask.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: row.id } });
    expect(saved.state).toBe('cancelled'); expect(saved.command).toEqual(flow.body.command);
    expect(await f.db.ticketEvent.count({ where: { ticketId: flow.ticket.id } })).toBe(0);
  });
});
